{{Top|leg}}
The '''EM Whip''' was an exotic and powerful weapon mounted on the ''[[Teljkon Vagabond]]''.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> The weapon consisted of two slender, spiked projectiles that buried themselves into a target's hull. An enormously powerful electrical current was passed through the completed circuit that knocked out all [[Starship/Legends|starship]] systems and killed or incapacitated the vessel's crew.<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
